description: List the block-storage volumes in a region: size, status, type, and the instance or cluster each is attached to (unattached volumes still bill). Civo: GET /v2/volumes.

region.description: Region code, e.g. LON1, NYC1, FRA1, PHX1 (see civo_list_regions). Defaults to CIVO_REGION; Civo resources are regional, so pass the region the resource lives in.

name: civo_list_volumes
title: List volumes
